about: The mildest blend in the Kafie 1901 core line, with an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Dominican tobaccos aged at least four years. It was first made in Honduras and has been rolled at La Aurora in the Dominican Republic since 2022.
notes: Maker rates strength 6/10 and body 7/10. Maker lists all-Dominican filler; halfwheel and Neptune add Nicaraguan filler. Maker says it has been in the portfolio since 2014, while halfwheel reported it shipping in April 2015.

about: The first Kafie 1901 blend, named for founder Dr. Gaby Kafie's father, Don Fernando. It launched in 2013 as a Honduran-made cigar and was reblended at La Aurora in 2022 with a Cameroon binder and Dominican andullo in the filler.
notes: Also sold as DF Maduro or Kafie 1901 Maduro. Maker rates strength and body 8/10; Neptune lists it as Medium. The 2013 original was made at Tabacalera Puros Aliados in Honduras with a different binder and filler.

about: A Kafie 1901 core line blend that the maker calls its boldest, pairing a double-fermented Mexican San Andrés wrapper with an all-Nicaraguan binder and filler. It debuted in 2016 as a Honduran-made cigar and was reworked when production moved to La Aurora in 2022.
notes: Maker rates strength 7/10 and body 8/10; Neptune lists it as Full. The 2016 original was box pressed, made in Honduras, and had a Honduran binder with Brazilian and Dominican filler. It was first announced under the name La Union.
verifyNotes: All fields confirmed. Swapped the 2023 halfwheel link for the Neptune page, which is where the Maduro wording on the wrapper and the Full rating in the notes come from.

about: A core Kafie 1901 blend with a sun-grown Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper that the maker calls its bestseller. It started as a Honduran-made cigar and has been rolled at La Aurora in the Dominican Republic since 2022.
notes: Maker rates strength and body 7/10; Neptune lists it as Medium. Maker lists Brazilian filler, while halfwheel and Neptune list Peruvian pelo de oro instead. Maker says 'since 2014' but halfwheel reported a November 2015 release.

about: A Dominican puro made to mark founder Dr. Gaby Kafie's 50th birthday; the L is the Roman numeral for 50. He blended it with La Aurora master blender Manuel Inoa, and it was the first blend to come out of Kafie's partnership with that factory.
notes: Maker rates strength 7/10 and body 6/10; Neptune lists it as Medium. Halfwheel listed the Belicoso at 54 ring, while the maker and Neptune list 52.

about: The Connecticut-wrapped version of Kafie 1901's value-priced house blend, made with long filler at La Aurora. The version now sold has a sweetened tip.
notes: Current version is sweet tipped (added 2024) and boxed; the unsweetened 2022 bundle came in four sizes. Maker calls it mild to medium (5/10); Neptune lists Medium. The Liga de la Casa name dates to 2018, but halfwheel first reports a Connecticut version in the 2022 La Aurora relaunch.
verifyNotes: Fields confirmed. Reworded the last note: the 2018 Liga de la Casa came only in habano and San Andres maduro, so 2022 stands for the Connecticut. Flavors come from the maker's Connecticut coffee pairing page.

about: The maduro version of Kafie 1901's value-priced house blend, made with long filler at La Aurora. The version now sold has a sweetened tip.
notes: Maker lists an Ecuadorian habano maduro wrapper; halfwheel and Neptune call it Honduran. Sold since 2018 as a Honduran-made bundle with a San Andrés maduro wrapper, then remade with long filler at La Aurora in 2022 and given a sweet tip in 2024. Maker calls it mild to medium; Neptune lists Medium.

about: The natural habano version of Kafie 1901's value-priced house blend, made with long filler at La Aurora. The version now sold has a sweetened tip.

line: Liga de la Casa Sweet Tip
wrapperLeaf: Ecuadorian Connecticut, Ecuadorian Habano Natural or Ecuadorian Habano Maduro
about: Kafie 1901's first sweet-tipped cigars, shown at the 2024 PCA trade show. The line comes in three wrapper versions, Connecticut, Habano Natural and Habano Maduro, all made at La Aurora.
notes: Three blends under one name, so the wrapper depends on the version; these are the same cigars as the current Liga de la Casa Connecticut, Natural and Maduro. Kafie did not disclose the blends at launch; the binder and filler come from its own store listing. Neptune calls the two habano wrappers Honduran.
verifyNotes: Fields confirmed. Added to the notes that this is the same product as the three Liga de la Casa wrapper entries, which the maker store tags as Sweet Tip.

about: The Connecticut version of Kafie 1901's unbanded bundle line, made at La Aurora. It uses mixed (medium) filler from tobacco left over from rolling the company's other blends.
notes: Mixed filler, not long filler, and sold without bands. Maker lists an Indonesian binder; Neptune lists Honduran. Halfwheel dates this La Aurora version to 2023 but mentioned an earlier Naked bundle in 2022.
verifyNotes: Fields confirmed. Replaced the strength rating sentence in the notes with a caution on the 2023 date, since halfwheel in September 2022 spoke of an updated version of Naked Cigars. Halfwheel lists the Churchill at 7 x 47; maker and Neptune say 7 x 48.

about: A limited Kafie 1901 release named for the stilt houses in Miami's Biscayne Bay, blended by Dr. Gaby Kafie with La Aurora's Manuel Inoa. Its binder and filler were aged for about a year in barrels that once held Dominican rum.
notes: Binder and filler are not disclosed. It was shown at PCA 2025 with 500 boxes of each size planned, but halfwheel reported in April 2026 that the release was pushed to fall 2026, so check whether it has shipped.

about: A one-size lancero made by Kafie for the Limited Cigar Association, released on December 27, 2021. The name means 'old year' and it was meant to be smoked on New Year's Eve.
notes: Sold as Año Viejo by Kafie through Limited Cigar Association retailers, not as part of the regular Kafie 1901 line. Production numbers were not disclosed.

wrapperLeaf: Ecuadorian Habano Natural, Ecuadorian Connecticut, Mexican San Andrés or Mexican San Andrés Maduro, depending on the blend
about: A 2021 set of six small-run blends from Kafie's own Honduran factory, built from tobacco lots too small for a regular line. They were sold in 10-count bundles through Kafie's BoutiqueSmoke.com store.
notes: Six releases with four different wrappers, so there is no single wrapper. Each release was limited to 2,000 cigars. Kafie left the Honduran factory in late 2021.
verifyNotes: Blend, sizes and run size confirmed. The listed article only says "our factory", so I added the halfwheel article that names Tabacalera G. Kafie y Cia. in Danli and dates Kafie's exit to October 31, 2021. No strength is published.
